Suggested attendees from our side: myself (strategic lead), Karthik (solutions / technical), Naomi (customer success / onboarding). Happy to keep it light on the first call — goal is alignment on success criteria and next steps.

Proposed times (PST):
- Tue 8/24 10:00–10:45
- Wed 8/25 14:00–14:45
- Thu 8/26 09:00–09:45

I'll attach a one-page MA plan template and a product one-pager so you can see how we position the pilot.

Thanks — looking forward to coordinating.

Hi Hannah —

Appreciate the note. Yes — we'd like to move this forward. I'll loop in our AWS partner manager, Jason Reed, so we can align on co-sell process and next steps. Our primary objectives for the pilot are:

- Validate clinician triage improvements in the ED workflow
- Measure token-cost / latency trade-offs for 8k context summaries
- Define success metrics for a Q4 POC and procurement runway

All three proposed slots look workable; Jason will weigh in on his availability. I also want our procurement lead, Priya Kulkarni (cc'd in a follow-up), at the kickoff once we finalize the date.

Thanks,

Thanks Nora — welcome, Jason (if you see this thread).

I've attached a very small Mutual Action Plan (MA Plan) template that we use for co-sell pilots. It captures milestones, owners, success criteria, and procurement checkpoints (attachment: Helix_MA_Plan_v1.xlsx). A couple of operational notes up-front:

- Pilot scope: 6-week technical POC with 1 ED site, initial integration via API.
- Success metrics: 15–20% triage-time reduction, <250ms median serving latency (target), and ROI estimate for 3-month run-rate.
- Risk items: PHI handling — we'll propose VPC-private deployment for log separation during the pilot, plus SOC2 evidence.

Proposed agenda (30–45m):
1) Intros & success criteria (5m)
2) AWS co-sell runway and partner roles (10m)
3) Tech approach & pilot scope (10m)
4) Procurement & timeline (5–10m)
5) Actions & owners (5m)

Hannah — if that agenda looks good, can you pick one of Nora's slots and I'll prepare the MA plan and a short technical appendix to share ahead of the call.

Cheers,
